title: Καινὴ ἱστορία / New History (for Polymaths) / «Новая история» (Photius, Bibliotheca cod. 190)
author: Ptolemy Chennus (Ptolemy Hephaestion)
size: Survives only in Photius' summary (Westermann 1843 pp. 182–192). Estimate 5–6k words.
edition: A. Westermann 1843 (PD). R. Henry, Photius Bibliothèque III (Budé 1962).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Птолемей Хенн): only excerpts (Latyshev, ВДИ 1947 №4, pp. 277–278) plus a content paraphrase. Vasilik's new Russian Photius (vol. 1, 2024) may later include it.
en_evidence: tertullian.org has only an English rendering of Henry's French (indirect), cited on en.wikipedia.
value: A parody of Alexandrian scholarship and a showcase of invented sources and myths. Excellent for a commentary that exposes the fakery. Short and attractive to general readers.
ai_feasibility: high: narrative summary. The commentary must check the alleged sources.
